verdict.rationale: Clerky has a Partner API and a remote MCP server, but the API only supports Delaware C-Corporation formation document sets, with OAuth access still 'coming soon'. The MCP server is described as read-only with team-scoped access. Nothing in the evidence shows an agent drafting an NDA or routing one for signature through either surface, so these interfaces are adjacent rather than delivering this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent draft an NDA and route it for signature end-to-end via the product's API or MCP server

citations.quote: It currently supports Delaware C-Corporation formations.
per docs read-only tools with team-scoped access
